SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

7. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

15. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
